title: Rational elements are the absolute Galois invariants
statement: Let $\Omega$ be an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], with its fixed inclusion $\mathbf Q\hookrightarrow\Omega$. For $x\in\Omega$, the following are equivalent: there exists $r\in\mathbf Q$ whose image in $\Omega$ is $x$; and $\sigma(x)=x$ for every $\mathbf Q$-automorphism $\sigma:\Omega\xrightarrow{\sim}\Omega$ [def-weil-field-extension-isomorphism].
